author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
GO:0051652 maintenance of chromosome localization (no EXP annotations)
GO:0051303 establishment of chromosome localization

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/23796

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here:  https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1eY_ibpIaCy41zDbJ4RdLL6MR3_hicV7yUHYw3_F5HdQ/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
UniProt 4
ARUK-UCL 1 - done


No mappings

Thanks.
